Raisin water, also known as kishmish water, is a popular traditional morning drink. Raisins are dried grapes, so their natural sugars and nutrients are concentrated into a smaller portion. Soaking them overnight softens the fruit and allows some soluble substances, including natural sugars, to pass into the water.
In this video, Hansaji explains how to prepare raisin water and what it can contribute to your daily diet.
You will learn about:
1. How to prepare raisin water using 10–15 washed raisins soaked overnight.
